title: Phil Ruvinsky - Sustainable Competitive Advantages in Technology

reader_summary.headline: In this episode, Michael Mauboussin, adjunct professor at Columbia Business School, hosts Phil Ruvinsky.
reader_summary.overview: In this episode, Michael Mauboussin, adjunct professor at Columbia Business School, hosts Phil Ruvinsky, Managing Director and Head of the Fundamental U.S. With extensive experience in the investment industry, Phil shares his journey from law to finance, discusses his investment philosophy. The conversation explores the evaluation of management, the impact of AI on the competitive landscape, and the nuances of portfolio construction.

key_points.text: With extensive experience in the investment industry, Phil shares his journey from law to finance, discusses his investment philosophy.
Phil also highlights the role of macroeconomic factors and regulatory changes in investment decisions.
